theorems.name: Submission.regcomp_null_compact_ball_cover
theorems.statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (Z : Set (Euclid P)), IsCompact Z → μH[(m : ℝ)] Z = 0 → ∀ ε δ : ℝ, 0 < ε → 0 < δ → ∃ (J : ℕ) (p : Fin J → Euclid P) (σ : Fin J → ℝ), (∀ j, p j ∈ Z) ∧ (∀ j, 0 < σ j ∧ σ j < δ) ∧ Z ⊆ ⋃ j, ball (p j) (σ j) ∧ ∑ j, σ j ^ m < ε
